<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use App\Services\GraphQLExecutor;

class ProductSearchController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Handle GraphQL product search queries from internal microservices.
     * This endpoint processes raw GraphQL for flexible product filtering.
     */
    public function search(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'query' => 'required|string|max:4096',
            'variables' => 'nullable|array',
        ]);

        $graphqlQuery = $request->input('query');
        $variables = $request->input('variables', []);

        // Extract filter arguments from the GraphQL query for SQL optimization
        $filters = $this->extractFiltersFromQuery($graphqlQuery, $variables);

        // Direct SQL path for performance on simple product searches
        if ($this->isSimpleProductQuery($graphqlQuery)) {
            return $this->executeOptimizedSearch($filters);
        }

        // Fall through to full GraphQL execution for complex queries
        $executor = new GraphQLExecutor();
        return response()->json($executor->execute($graphqlQuery, $variables));
    }

    private function extractFiltersFromQuery(string $query, array $variables): array
    {
        $filters = [];

        // Parse category filter from GraphQL arguments
        if (preg_match('/category:\s*"([^"]+)"/', $query, $matches)) {
            $filters['category'] = $matches[1];
        } elseif (preg_match('/category:\s*\$([a-zA-Z]+)/', $query, $matches)) {
            $varName = $matches[1];
            if (isset($variables[$varName])) {
                $filters['category'] = $variables[$varName];
            }
        }

        // Parse name search filter
        if (preg_match('/nameContains:\s*"([^"]+)"/', $query, $matches)) {
            $filters['name_search'] = $matches[1];
        } elseif (preg_match('/nameContains:\s*\$([a-zA-Z]+)/', $query, $matches)) {
            $varName = $matches[1];
            if (isset($variables[$varName])) {
                $filters['name_search'] = $variables[$varName];
            }
        }

        // Parse price range
        if (preg_match('/maxPrice:\s*(\d+)/', $query, $matches)) {
            $filters['max_price'] = (int) $matches[1];
        }

        return $filters;
    }

    private function isSimpleProductQuery(string $query): bool
    {
        // Check if this is a simple products query we can optimize
        return (bool) preg_match('/^\s*\{?\s*query\s*[^{]*\{\s*products\s*\(/', $query)
            || (bool) preg_match('/^\s*\{\s*products\s*\(/', $query);
    }

    private function executeOptimizedSearch(array $filters): \Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse
    {
        $sql = "SELECT id, name, category, price, description FROM products WHERE 1=1";

        if (isset($filters['category'])) {
            // VULNERABILITY: Direct string interpolation into SQL
            $sql .= " AND category = '" . $filters['category'] . "'";
        }

        if (isset($filters['name_search'])) {
            // VULNERABILITY: Direct string interpolation into SQL
            $sql .= " AND name LIKE '%" . $filters['name_search'] . "%'";
        }

        if (isset($filters['max_price'])) {
            $sql .= " AND price <= " . $filters['max_price'];
        }

        $sql .= " ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 50";

        try {
            $results = DB::select($sql);
            return response()->json([
                'data' => [
                    'products' => $results
                ]
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'errors' => [['message' => 'Search failed']]
            ], 500);
        }
    }
}
